item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[elsie,eva,wynter,neil]).

% Elsie does not embrace uncertainty.
axiom(s1,not(embraces_uncertainty(elsie))).
% Elsie does not face adversity.
axiom(s2,not(faces_adversity(elsie))).
% Eva values self-improvement.
axiom(s3,values_self_improvement(eva)).
% If Wynter loses direction in life, then she will find a new purpose.
axiom(s4,rule([loses_direction_in_life(wynter)],find_new_purpose(wynter))).
% If someone faces challenges and stays curious, then they take risks.
axiom(s5,rule([faces_challenges(X),stays_curious(X)],takes_risks(X))).
% If Eva pursues her passion, then she discovers resilience and has a setback.
axiom(s6,rule([pursues_passion(eva)],and(discovers_resilience(eva),has_setback(eva)))).
% If Elsie pursues her passion, then she discovers resilience and has a setback.
axiom(s7,rule([pursues_passion(elsie)],and(discovers_resilience(elsie),has_setback(elsie)))).
% Eva does not embrace uncertainty.
axiom(s8,not(embraces_uncertainty(eva))).
% Eva reflects on her actions.
axiom(s9,reflects_on_actions(eva)).
% If someone takes risks and reflects on their actions, then they gain wisdom.
axiom(s10,rule([takes_risks(X),reflects_on_actions(X)],gains_wisdom(X))).
% If Neil overcomes obstacles, then she either learns from her mistakes or gains wisdom (or both).
axiom(s11,rule([overcomes_obstacles(neil)],or(learns_from_mistakes(neil),gains_wisdom(neil)))).
% If someone meets a dead end, then they have experienced failure.
axiom(s12,rule([meets_a_dead_end(X)],experienced_failure(X))).
% Wynter did not lose direction in life.
axiom(s13,not(loses_direction_in_life(wynter))).
% Neil is adventurous.
axiom(s14,adventurous(neil)).
% If Eva achieves success, then she either develops patience or gains wisdom (but not both).
axiom(s15,rule([achieves_success(eva)],xor(develops_patience(eva),gains_wisdom(eva)))).
% Eva is adventurous.
axiom(s16,adventurous(eva)).
% Elsie values self-improvement.
axiom(s17,values_self_improvement(elsie)).
% Anyone who is adventurous either takes risks or embraces uncertainty (or both).
axiom(s18,rule([adventurous(X)],or(takes_risks(X),embraces_uncertainty(X)))).
% If Eva values self-improvement, then she pursues her passion and has mentorship.
axiom(s19,rule([values_self_improvement(eva)],and(pursues_passion(eva),has_mentorship(eva)))).
% If Wynter values self-improvement, then she pursues her passion and has mentorship.
axiom(s20,rule([values_self_improvement(wynter)],and(pursues_passion(wynter),has_mentorship(wynter)))).","query":"labelled_explanation(implies(or(has_setback(eva),experienced_failure(eva)),find_new_purpose(eva)),Status,Package)"}
